text: Rivalz Testnet Airdrop: Celebrating the community Home Sign in Subscribe Rivalz Testnet Airdrop: Celebrating the community Vlad | Rivalz 20 Feb 2025 — 3 min read Share The Rivalz team extends a big thank you to its entire community for the support and enthusiasm that made the Incentivized Testnet the success it was. More than 1,8m users joined, 250,000,000 transactions were executed and over 42,000,000 clients deployed in half a year. The progress Rivalz has made since the testnet’s start simply would not have been possible without the dedicated efforts of every participant and collaborator. Rivalz Incentivized Testnet Completed! The Rivalz Testnet, which concluded on January 24, 2025, demonstrated the network’s capability to evolve and support a large user base. From registering millions of rClients to carrying out hundreds of millions of transactions, the Testnet proved that Rivalz can scale effectively while providing a robust AI-focused infrastructure. This period of testing was crucial in paving the way for ROME, the next major milestone in Rivalz’s journey toward a self-sovereign AI economy. Rivalz Airdrop: 7% of the $RIZ Supply In recognition of the community’s efforts, Rivalz is allocating 7% of the total $RIZ supply (350,000,000 $RIZ) as part of the Rivalz Airdrop , offering meaningful rewards to both dedicated internal contributors and external communities that share Rivalz’s vision to build the World Abstraction Layer for AI and Agents. Of this allocation, 76% is dedicated to the Rivalz Community, which includes Testnet participation, various social engagements, and community activities, while the remaining 24% is reserved for external community partners. Rivalz Testnet Eligibility Out of the 1,800,000 testnet users, after filtering out over 300,000 sybil accounts and 200,000 unqualified users, about 1,200,000 users are eligible for the airdrop. Eligibility was based on meeting minimum point requirements in each epoch. rClient Points Requirements: Epoch 1: Minimum of 2,000 points Epoch 2: Minimum of 1,000 points Epoch 3: Minimum of 1,000 points Social Engagement Requirements: Epoch 1: Minimum of 500 points each Epoch 2: Minimum of 500 points each Epoch 3: Minimum of 5,000 points Referral points were added to the corresponding categories as an amplifier. In addition to testnet users, Rivalz is also rewarding the most active community members - SuperAgentz and Harbingerz . Alongside them, the top 5,000 users on our Rivalz Galxe leaderboard will also be able to claim RIZ airdrop. All of these eligible users can check their allocation and claim their airdrop through the Rivalz Airdrop Portal . Stay tuned on our official channels for Note: The testnet closed on January 24, 2025. All additional points (like AG Points from Alliance projects and community activities) were included in the final airdrop allocation. The Galxe snapshot was also taken on January 24, 2025. Сommunities Eligibility Rivalz is giving special rewards to the communities of its strategic partners: Chainlink, Dymension, Aethir, Pixelmon, Yumio, and Puffer Finance. Below you can see how these rewards are going to be distributed. Chainlink, Aethir, Pixelmon, & Puffer Finance : Will handle distributions directly. Youmio (prev. Today The Game): Rewards will be Airdroped to both staked and unstaked Ancient Seed Holders. They won’t be required to claim on the Airdrop Portal. Dymension : Users must have staked at least 150 DYM and need to have completed at least one transaction on Dymension within 30 days before the snapshot on January 24th, 2025. Eligible wallets can then claim rewards through the Rivalz Airdrop Claim Portal by connecting their associated EVM wallet. Claim Your Rewards Eligible participants will be able to claim their $RIZ airdrop on February 21st, 2025 at 14:00 UTC through Rivalz’s official claiming portal . Prior to that, users will be able to check their airdrop allocation, ensuring transparency and clarity about their rewards. To claim, participants should connect the same wallet they used during the Testnet to confirm eligibility. Stay tuned to Rivalz’s socials for more information regarding the claiming process. The claim portal will close on the 14th March 2025. Unclaimed tokens will be burned! Beyond Testnet: All Roads Lead to ROME The Rivalz Testnet laid the foundation for ROME, which represents the core of Rivalz’s self-sovereign AI economy. By transforming social capital, compute, and data into tokenized AI agents (rAgents), ROME allows users to stake and pool these rAgents into large-scale agent collectives known as Swarms. Far more than just a protocol, ROME introduces a dynamic economic frontier where humans and AI collaborate. ROME will introduce multiple seasons with new activities and exciting developments in which users will be able to get more RIZ rewards. During Season 1 Rivalz is allocating 25,000,000 RIZ tokens for ROME Season 1. Testnet participants eligible for the Rivalz Airdrop will also receive bonus rewards when they engage with ROME’s Swarm Protocol features post-TGE. Important Disclaimer: Rivalz urges everyone to be cautious of scams or phishing attempts. Always verify that you are interacting with official Rivalz links and receiving updates exclusively from Rivalz’s official social channels.
